summary: 9-year-old autistic child reported missing after running west from Mountain Shadows Montessori School into City of Boulder OSMP open space; located unharmed at 10:11 a.m. by a BCSO deputy and K-9 bloodhound plus an OSMP ranger, after a multi-agency search with drones and search dogs
location: Mountain Shadows Montessori School / City of Boulder OSMP open space
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder Emergency Squad; Front Range Rescue Dogs; OSMP rangers
notes: BCSO case 24-05433; reported missing ~8:57 a.m., found unharmed 10:11 a.m.; BES drones, FRRD search dogs, Deputy Scrudder + K-9 'Watson' and OSMP Ranger Kelly McBride credited in release
